_comment: Video bounds for the comparison series only -- kept separate from config/countries.json's global "video" block (45-80s) so this series' own target doesn't get clamped up to the other series' minimum, and so it doesn't affect them either. Passed as --video-config to generate_comparison_script.py / render_comparison_graphics.py and as --config to assemble_video.py for this series' runs only. Widened from an initial 30-40s: at that cap, natural-paced narration for 4 stat rows either got cut off mid-sentence or had to be read unnaturally fast to fit -- 35-60s gives the voice room to breathe at a normal pace, right at YouTube Shorts' 60s ceiling. 2026-10-14: the cloned voice reads this numbers-heavy script at ~1.45 words/s, not 2.3, so live videos had 80-88 s of voice cut to 60 s (the verdict was lost); words_per_second now matches the real voice and the cap is 85 s (Shorts allow 3 minutes).
